title: Knowledge Growth Strategy
definition: A strategy that involves expanding and enhancing a knowledge base through various methods, such as gameplay, context enrichment, collaborative reasoning, and knowledge integration.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine growing a tree. We nurture its growth through various activities, like playing games, reading books, discussing ideas, and even letting it learn from other trees. This helps it grow wiser and more knowledgeable.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The strategy involves enriching a model's knowledge through methods such as fine-tuning, prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation, and inter-model knowledge transfer. It aims to create a rich, dynamic knowledge base that enhances the model's capabilities over time.
difficulty_levels.expert: The strategy encompasses a variety of methods to expand and enhance a knowledge base, fostering a sense of continuous growth and learning. It incorporates both model-based learning (fine-tuning, inter-model knowledge transfer) and data-based learning (prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation). This strategy not only improves the model's performance but also challenges traditional notions of 'training' and 'knowledge acquisition', promoting a more dynamic, evolving understanding of the world.

extra_fields.insight: The strategy involves nurturing a model's growth through a variety of methods, creating a rich, dynamic knowledge base that enhances capabilities over time, challenging traditional notions of 'training' and 'knowledge acquisition'.
